days.title: Overnight flight
days.body: Depart San Francisco late morning. In the air across the date line.

days.title: Arrive and dinner at Aoba Counter
days.body: Mid-afternoon landing, drop bags at Maple House, evening vegetarian tasting menu (already booked on TableCheck).

days.title: Walk-in ramen and a neighbourhood walk
days.body: Lunch at Midori Bowl — vegetable broth, no booking. Afternoon at Sample Park Ridge.

days.title: Optional Tabelog lunch
days.body: Nishi Market Diner is recommended, not required. Book on Tabelog a few days ahead if you want a table.

days.title: A slower Tokyo day
days.body: Free day before the morning Shinkansen. No reservations on this sample day.

days.title: Morning Shinkansen to Kyoto
days.body: Checkout at 11:00 is after the 09:33 Hikari — leave bags or take an earlier checkout. Reserved seats already booked.
